value.rationale: Exact failure probabilities and different sharp guaranteed sample fractions for all four-coordinate subspaces give a natural, reproducible benchmark for least-squares/sketch injectivity. The same row-leverage profile masks an exponential difference in failure rates. This distinguishes the invariant from arbitrary slicing, textbook substitution, or a purely computational curiosity.
